description_en: Query the IP address status information in the connection address pool
description_zh: 查询连接地址池中的IP地址状态信息
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc list-connection-pool-ips --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --max-results 10 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --connection-pool-id cp-bp11234abctmno0hdq0000 --ip 192.168.XX.XX --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListConnectionPoolIps

parameters.help_en:
A token used to mark the starting position for the current read operation. An empty value indicates reading from the beginning.

Do not provide this parameter in the first call. The response will include a NextToken for the second call. Each subsequent response will contain the NextToken for the next call
parameters.help_zh:
用来标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始。

第一次调用不用填写，会在返回结果中包含第二次调用时用的NextToken，之后每次调用返回结果中都有下一次调用时的NextToken
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: Paging size. Valid values: 1 to 2000. If left empty, the default value is 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，取值：1~2000。传入为空时，默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The Region ID where the cloud connector instance is located. Valid value: cn-hangzhou only
parameters.help_zh: 云连接器实例所在的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the cloud connector
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the connection address pool
parameters.name: connection_pool_id

parameters.help_en: IP address in the connection address pool
parameters.name: ip

ConnectionPoolIps.description_en: List of IPs in the connection address pool

items.description_en: List of IPs in the connection address pool

Ip.description_en: IP address in the connection address pool

Status.description_en: IP address status. The only valid value is activated, which indicates that the IP address has been activated and successfully attached to a cloud connector
Status.description_zh: IP地址状态，仅取值activated，表示已激活，IP地址和云连接器绑定完成

NextToken.description_en: Token indicating the start of the next query. An empty value indicates that there is no next page
NextToken.description_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，为空表示没有下一个

TotalCount.description_en: Total number of IPs in the connection address pool
